content.name: application-security-engineering
content.description: Design, implement, or remediate general application security controls: code-linked threat models, authentication and recovery, sessions, authorization and tenant isolation, OAuth/JWT, browser/API/uploads, secrets and data protection, secure failure, dependency policy, or ASVS implementation. Independent assessments belong to security-review; specialist LLM/RAG/agent threat modeling, security design/review, hardening and authorized testing belong to genai-security-testing.
